offers_products.reason: Main offering is imaging services; eRAD software and AI are a smaller side division.

offers_services.reason: Operates 442 outpatient diagnostic imaging centers delivering MRI, ultrasound and mammography exams.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Patients receive imaging exams at its outpatient centers and can self-pay.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Health plans, referring physicians, and hospital and health system joint-venture partners are key customers.

recurring_revenue.reason: Patients get episodic exams on physician referral; not subscription or contract-based.

cyclical_demand.reason: Medically necessary diagnostic imaging ordered by physicians and paid mostly by insurers is rarely postponed.

big_ticket.reason: Individual imaging exams are routine, relatively small and frequent across many patients.

people_delivered.reason: Service depends heavily on costly imaging equipment and centers, not only radiologist time.

large_customers.reason: Main buyers are patients and referring physicians, though insurers are large payers.

asset_heavy.reason: Needs costly MRI and CT equipment and a network of 442 imaging centers to grow.

notes: Main business is imaging centers; the eRAD software/AI division is smaller.
